content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Courses teachable

Platforms like Teachable, Gumroad, and Stripe offer convenience at the cost of dependency. They handle hosting, payment processing, and delivery—until they don’t. Sovereign stacks like COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offer ownership. You deploy your store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages (free), use Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto payments. The tradeoff is clear: platforms rent you tools; sovereign stacks give you infrastructure. One is a service; the other is a system. If Stripe or PayPal reject your country, platforms fail. Sovereign stacks do not.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe operates in 46 countries out of 195. PayPal suspends accounts in Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan without warning. Teachable and Gumroad depend on these payment processors, so they fail where Stripe and PayPal fail. Sovereign stacks bypass this entirely. NOWPayments processes 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and no buyer account required. Transactions confirm on-chain within minutes. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON keep fees under $0.10. This is not a workaround—it’s base-layer infrastructure that works where platforms cannot.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Platforms charge 5–10% per transaction plus payment processor fees. A $50 course sale might net you $38.50 after fees. Sovereign stacks using NOWPayments charge 0.5%—a $50 sale costs $0.25. Crypto payments confirm in minutes, not days. The real cost is deployment time. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack deploys in 48 hours, configured end-to-end, with 5 products loaded and email security set up. After deployment, you own the stack. No subscriptions. No platform fees. No country restrictions. The tradeoff is upfront cost versus lifetime ownership.
Platforms rent you tools. Sovereign stacks give you infrastructure.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Platforms own your data, your customer relationships, and your revenue stream. They can suspend your account or change their terms overnight. Sovereign stacks give you full ownership. Your store lives on your GitHub or Cloudflare account. Orders are stored in your Supabase database. Files are delivered from your Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Automation is handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. COREMERCH deploys, tests, and hands off the stack—then has no access. You own the infrastructure. You control the revenue. You decide the terms.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you’re in a country Stripe or PayPal rejects, platforms are not an option. They will fail you. Sovereign stacks are the only structural solution. If you sell digital products like courses, templates, or presets, COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is built for your use case. It’s deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested, and includes 30-day support. If you prefer to build your own, the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) provides full documentation and source code. The choice is clear: rent a platform that may fail you, or own infrastructure that cannot.
